answer: Fixed schedules let forgers rest fakes between checks. Random beacon sampling fixes it: a VRF beacon draws 5% each epoch; the chosen submit a beacon-bound proof in 2 epochs. Draws are secret: a forger cannot rest 1,000 idle identities and wake only the checked. Absence freezes rewards 6 epochs; a second miss slashes 50% of stake. The cipher binds proof to beacon — one proof cannot cover an island of fakes. A forger with 1,000 identities locking 120,000 units loses an expected 6,000 per round to misses. The wharf is watched at random hours.
